outlook.statement: Grow customer base sustainably and responsibly; strengthen digital and technology capabilities; improve operational efficiency and quality of earnings; maintain strong governance, compliance and risk-management standards; expand reach as India's investor base continues to grow; create sustainable long-term value for shareholders.
The Company's tight control on cost, retaining client base and improving infrastructure is expected to improve the profit before depreciation, interest and tax over the years.

Indian securities broking industry undergoing structural transformation driven by financialization of savings, smartphone penetration, and digital onboarding. Total demat accounts surpassed 230 million, unique registered investors crossed 130 million. Tier-2/3 cities driving substantial new account additions. India remains fastest-growing major economy with GDP growth projected at 6.4-6.6% for FY2025-26. Structural shift from physical to financial assets catalyzing retail broking, mutual fund SIPs, and direct equity participation.

Global growth moderating to 2.5%-3.0% constrained by energy supply disruptions and geopolitical uncertainties; energy shocks from regional conflict catalyzing inflationary pressures; shifts in trade policies and technology restrictions introducing friction; Indian market showing structural resilience with DIIs and retail SIP inflows (consistently crossing Rs 30,000+ crore monthly) absorbing foreign liquidations.
